title: Phone version switch and parameter links
steps: On a phone (390x844), open /docs/30.2/api/server-configuration.html and look at the breadcrumb row under the nav.
Tap the version at the start of the breadcrumb, look at the list, then tap the same version to close it.
Scroll to the Common Parameters table and look at the parameter names.
expect_head: The breadcrumb starts with a tappable v30.2 that opens the version list. Each parameter shows a muted # before its name. Tapping it puts #--api-key in the URL and lands that row just under the pinned bars.
expect_base: The breadcrumb has no version on phones. Parameter names stand alone with no # and nothing to tap.
note: From 768px up HEAD hides this breadcrumb version again so tablets show one picker (fc63b9ee). That width is covered by the one-version-picker-per-width gate, not this clip. Frames checked. HEAD shows v30.2 first in the breadcrumb, the tap opens the version list (3.3s), each parameter has a muted # and tapping the --api-key # lands that row under the pinned bars with #--api-key in the URL (7.4s). Base has no breadcrumb version and no #. Light theme. A badge bottom left shows keys pressed and one bottom right names the step. The search cluster and trackers are blocked.
